title: Skill evals
description: Trigger and behavior evals for one skill. Lives at <skill>/evals/evals.json.

skill.description: Must match the skill directory name and SKILL.md `name`.

triggers.description: Prompts that test the SKILL.md description. The agent sees only the catalog of skill names and descriptions.

positive.description: Prompts that should cause the agent to load this skill.

negative.description: Near-miss prompts that should not load this skill. They may legitimately load a different skill.

behaviors.description: Task prompts run with the full skill loaded. A judge model grades the narrated response against the assertions.

context.description: Repository state the agent would otherwise discover with tools.
